method: Authenticated rendered learner UI; semantic controls, keyboard, DOM and viewport observation. No source or network inspection.
tested_interactions: decomposition month default and lower endpoint
lag default,14,24 with linked pairs and ACF
negative MA and high positive AR coefficient
ACF q0 and PACF p3 plus suggested-order restore
both models all-zero terms empty state
practice/learning stage return with state retained
limits: not every month, coefficient, model-order combination or distractor
underlying numerical series and software fits not independently reproduced
full keyboard,screen-reader,reduced-motion and cross-browser audit not performed; responsive spotcheck recorded separately
transfer_cautions: ADF unit-root null is more specific than all non-stationarity
residual diagnostics do not replace future-held-out evaluation
